note: Zebra crosswalk + stop-line iso ground tiles. COMPOSED from isoground/asphalt.png (128x81) by painting white iso markings onto the diamond TOP face only (apex (64,0), left (0,32), right (128,32), bottom (64,64)); the extruded asphalt sides below y=32 are left untouched. Markings lie flat on the iso plane (stripe edges parallel to a diamond edge at the 2:1 slope), never vertical. Same diamond format/metrics as env/isoground. zebra_s and zebra_e are the two perpendicular crosswalk orientations (stripes parallel to opposite diamond edges).
